prerequisites.title: A Todoist account
prerequisites.detail: The console is reached by signing in to a Todoist account; no paid plan, developer program or region requirement was found.

prerequisites.title: Composio auth config with your credentials
prerequisites.detail: Create the auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

steps.title: Open the App Management console
steps.detail: Sign in to Todoist and open Settings > Integrations > App Management.

steps.title: Create the app
steps.detail: Click Add new integration, enter an app name and click Create App.
steps.done_when: The app settings page shows a Client ID and Client secret.

steps.title: Copy the redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and add it to the Todoist app. Multiple redirect URLs can be registered, separated by commas.
steps.done_when: The redirect URI is saved in the Todoist app.

steps.title: Create the Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API using your client ID and secret. Request only the scopes your agent needs, for example data:read_write.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and the toolkit is todoist.

steps.title: Store the client secret securely
steps.detail: Anyone holding the secret can authorize apps against your integration. Resetting it invalidates the old value.
steps.done_when: The secret is in a secrets manager.

steps.title: Test a connection with a second account
steps.detail: Connect a Todoist account other than the app owner's to see whether the connection works for outside users without review.
steps.done_when: The second account is connected, or a restriction is seen.

traps.title: Enabling token refresh cannot be undone
traps.detail: Older apps may need token refresh enabled; it is a one-way change. Access tokens then expire after 1 hour and the app must use a refresh token.

traps.title: Scopes are set at authorization, not on the app
traps.detail: Scopes are requested when an account authorizes, not configured on the app. At least one scope is required.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio branding
traps.detail: With the managed app, users see 'Composio wants to access your account' and share quota with other Composio users.

traps.title: Request limits are unpublished
traps.detail: Exact limits are not published and apply per authenticated user. Read rate-limit headers and treat any 429 response as authoritative.

traps.title: Do not confuse the Todoist MCP toolkit
traps.detail: Composio lists a separate Todoist MCP toolkit under bring-your-own app. It is distinct from the Todoist toolkit.

blockers.symptom: Users on work or school accounts cannot connect the agent
blockers.what_it_means: Their organization administrator may need to permit third-party connections first.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the customer's admin to allow the connection; this is not controlled inside Todoist.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft a request message for the customer's admin.

blockers.what_it_means: The dynamic registration endpoint rejects restricted scopes and too many registrations in a short period.
blockers.what_to_do: Remove restricted scopes and retry later.
